data.name: Manzur
data.gender_notes: Manzur is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘manzura’, meaning ‘established, firm, victorious, triumphant, or settled’. This name holds a significant place in Islamic history, particularly for those who have achieved success and stability in their lives. The name Manzur carries the meaning “Victorious, Triumphant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Manzur usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious, triumphant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the triumph of faith over hardships and the attainment of spiritual victory.
data.etymology: Manzur belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious, Triumphant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manzur total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
